The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF WORK & SPECIFICATIONS 1. Supply, installation, testing and commissioning of 17 Nos. Intrinsically Safe VHF Handheld Sets and 1 No. VHF Base Station, including statutory liaisoning, at Indane Bottling Plant, Jamshedpur, Jharkha nd, with 3 Years Comprehensive Warranty, along with buy-back of the existing 11 Nos. VHF sets. 2. Supply of 17 Nos. Intrinsically Safe Digital VHF Handheld Radios (PESO approved, IS/IEC 60079 certi fied), each complete with Flameproof Battery, Charger, Helical Antenna, Belt Clip, User Manual and o ther standard accessories, with 3 Years Comprehensive Warranty. Detailed specifications are given below. S. No. DESCRIPTION SPECIFICATION 1 Type Digital VHF Intrinsically Safe Handheld Radio (PE SO approved, IS/IEC 60079 certified) with displa y & keypad 2 Make / Model No. Bidder to specify 3 RF Power Output Minimum 1 Watt

4 Frequency Range VHF (136 - 174 MHz) (The bidder shall set the fr equencies as assigned by WPC / DoT in the ame nded Wireless Operating Licence of Jamshedpur BP during installation) 5 Voltage of Operation Power Supply (Nominal): 7.2 to 7.5V DC through rechargeable battery Li-Ion IP68 minimum 2100 MAH Intrinsically Safe battery 6 Display Display with backlight supporting readability in outdoor sunlight conditions as well as nighttime. 7 Each unit to be supplied with Helical Antenna Intrinsically Safe Battery pack Battery Charger, Input voltage 230 Volt AC Belt Clip Operating Manual 8 Digital Sensitivity (5% BER) 0.16 μV typical 9 Audio Output Power Min 1 W 10 Security Offered Handheld Radio should have inbuilt sec urity feature to prevent unauthorized access to the radio system. 11 Water Intrusion IP68 12 Operating Temperature -30°C to +60°C 13 TEC/MTCTE Bidder must submit TEC/MTCTE certificate of the offered model in VHF band, certified under the p roduct name category ‘’VHF Radio System Equi pment’’ at the time of submitting the bid 14 Valid DOT/WPC License Bidder to submit valid DPL copy at the time of bi d submission. 15 PESO Approval Certificate Bidder must submit a valid PESO Approval certif icate for the offered model at the time of submit ting the bid. 16 Warranty 3 Years comprehensive warranty from the date of handover (covering handset, flameproof batt ery, charger, antenna and accessories)

17 Compatibility Handheld radios shall be fully compatible with t he offered Base Station and shall be programme d on the frequencies assigned by WPC / DoT for Jamshedpur BP. The above is the generic technical requirement of the digital radio handset; bidder may offer better. 3. Supply of 1 No. Digital VHF Base Station complete with all accessories required for operating the set and User Manual, along with tuning / programming with the VHF handheld sets (new sets and, during the changeover period, the existing sets), with 3 Years Comprehensive Warranty. Detailed specifications are given below SPECIFICATIONS FOR VHF BASE TRANSRECEIVER S. No. DESCRIPTION SPECIFICATION 1 Type Digital VHF Base Station / Base Radio 2 Make/ Model Bidder to specify 3 Frequency Band VHF (136 - 174 MHz) (The bidder shall set the frequencies as assigned by WPC / DoT in the amended Wireless Opera ting Licence of Jamshedpur BP during installation) 4 Display Alphanumeric Display 5 Each unit to be supplied with Fist microphone with cable, connector & hang-up clip Non-locking mounting bracket DC Power Cable Operator's handbook AC power supply unit (230 V AC input), antenna with RF ca ble & connectors and all other accessories required for op erating the set 6 RF Power Output 1 - 25 W 7 Rated Audio Minimum 2 Watt (Internal Speaker) 8 Operating Temperature -30°C to +60°C 9 Dust and Water Intrusion IP 54 10 Security Offered Base Radio should have inbuilt security to prevent unauthorized access to the radio system.

11 TEC/MTCTE Bidder must submit TEC/MTCTE certificate of the offered model in VHF band, certified under the product name cate gory ‘VHF Radio System Equipment’’ at the time of submit ting the bid 12 Tuning / Programming Base Station is a fresh installation (no base station exists at the plant) and shall be tuned / programmed to work wit h the 17 new handheld sets and, during the changeover p eriod, with the existing 11 VHF handheld sets. 13 Warranty 3 Years comprehensive warranty from the date of handov er The above is the generic technical requirement of the digital base station; bidder may offer better. Bidder to provide the specifications of the offered VHF Handheld Sets and Base Station at the time of subm ission of bid documents. 4. The existing Wireless Operating Licence No. NWW31720140711221 of Jamshedpur BP (Fixed/Land/ Mobile HF/VHF/UHF below 806 MHz, 11 licensed stations) is attached as Annex-6 for reference. Bidde r shall obtain / amend the operating licence for all 17 VHF handheld sets and 1 Base Station from the Department of Telecommunications / WPC (Wireless Planning and Coordination), Govt. of India, inclu ding frequency assignment, in coordination with IOCL. 5. Mast Height/Full site clearance should be obtained for fixed stations (if any) as required by WPC an d clearance from SACFA section of WPC should be obtained. Thereafter copy of invoice containing de tails of equipments supplied, SACFA clearance & other relevant documents shall be submitted to WP C for obtaining Wireless Operating licence. 6. The scope of works also includes consultancy / liaisoning with WPC / DoT or the concerned departm ent for amendment / modification of the existing licence (Ref. NWW31720140711221) so as to includ e the new VHF sets and Base Station and to delete the existing sets handed over under buy-back. 7. BUY-BACK OF EXISTING VHF SYSTEM: The existing 11 Nos. VHF handheld sets (procured in 1997, 20 05 and 2014) along with their batteries and chargers, lying at Jamshedpur BP, shall be bought back b y the successful bidder on "as-is-where-is" basis. The reserve price for the buy-back is Rs. 3,685.00 (i n total, inclusive of GST); the buy-back value quoted by the bidder against Item 50 shall not be less t han this reserve price. As per GeM, the buy-back price shall be inclusive of GST (GST @ 18% on the b uy-back material is indicated in the GeM bid). There is no existing base station at the plant; the buy-b ack covers only these 11 handheld sets. 8. Bidders may inspect the existing sets before bidding, by prior appointment with the contact persons given in the NIT. No claim regarding condition, quantity or performance of the existing sets shall be e ntertained after bid submission. 9. The existing sets shall be handed over / lifted by the bidder within 15 days after successful SAT and handover of the new system (so that plant communication is not interrupted), at the bidder's cost an d risk, including packing, loading and transport. The existing sets shall remain in use until then, and the Base Station shall be tuned to work with them during the changeover period. 10. The buy-back value (inclusive of GST) shall be adjusted against the payment due to the bidder, or pa id to IOCL before lifting of the sets, as decided by IOCL. IOCL shall issue the GST invoice at the time of lifting of the materials against buy-back, and the material shall be released only after settlement o f the buy-back value. 11. The bidder shall dispose of the sets, batteries and chargers in accordance with the E-Waste (Manage ment) Rules and Battery Waste Management Rules as applicable and shall furnish a disposal / recycli ng certificate to IOCL. Upon lifting, IOCL shall have no liability for the sets.

12. Warranty: The successful bidder must provide Standard warranty certificate from OEM and a 3 (three) years compreh ensive warranty on all supplied items (VHF handheld sets, flameproof batteries, chargers, antennas, belt cl ips, Base Station and accessories). The warranty period shall start from the date of handover to IOCL after successful SAT and the 30-day performance test, as recorded in the Minutes of Meeting. The comprehensive warranty shall cover all the materials supplied by the bidder, including flameproof batt eries, chargers, antennas and all accessories of the handheld sets and the Base Station. The scope of work under warranty will broadly cover the repair / replacement of faulty radios, Base Station and accessories, free of cost, including all spares, parts and labour. For warranty services, bidder must have a repair facility in India and tie-up with OEM for repair. Details to b e submitted by bidder along with the tender. Minor defects shall be attended at site, and major defects shall be attended at the authorized service cent re. Any component / spares required for repairing of the handheld sets, Base Station and accessories shall be in the scope of bidder. If any equipment is found defective during the warranty period and is not repairable at site, that equipmen t shall be taken by the bidder immediately after identification to the authorized centre or as instructed by EIC. The total time for repairing / replacement shall be 30 days including transportation. No extra payment shall be given for transportation, P&F, insurance etc. Any reprogramming of radios / Base Station required during the warranty period is included in the scope of work and the bidder should be equipped with the necessary software & instruments for the same. Bidder has to comply all safety rules/regulations/permissions & conditions appearing in the general conditi on of the IOCL contract (GCC) clauses as applicable. Also, Bidder has to follow all laws of the land such as li cense, safety and any other of state/central Government and of IOCL Jamshedpur LPG Bottling Plant while executing the job. All radios shall be serviced only by qualified persons, so as not to degrade the hazardous area certification of the device. For any emergency call during the warranty period, bidder shall deploy qualified skilled manpower, if requi red, to attend the emergency maintenance job, as & when necessary, without any time delay & commerci al implications to IOCL. All the necessary tools and tackles are to be arranged by the bidder. 13. Certification: Standard certificate declaring the handset as intrinsically safe from OEM (PESO certified) to be provided. R adio units (handsets and flameproof batteries) shall be intrinsically safe certified (IS/IEC 60079; ATEX/IECE x equivalent acceptable) with minimum “ib” certification for zone 1 Gr II B/C. The successful vendor has to submit the valid PESO approval for the VHF radio sets that are to be supplied. 14. Completion Period of Work: An application for the Wireless Operating Licence / amendment of the existing licence for the supplied VHF sets and Base Station (including induction of Base Station frequency) is to be submitted by the bidder withi n 15 days after issuance of work order. The completion time for the supply, installation, testing and commi ssioning work is 90 days from the date of issuance of the licence by WPC, MoC&IT or from the date of issua nce of the work order, whichever is later. 15. Bidder is responsible for online application for license/amendment through ONLINE Portal “SARAL SA NCHAR” https://www.eservices.dot.gov.in/saral-sanchar (saralsanchar.gov.in) or any other mode as applicable and to follow up with the authority/ WPC/DOT to get the amendment / approval as soon as possible. 16. Tenderers must submit dealer possession license (DPL) from department of Telecommunication (DO T)/GOI along with the tender document. Also, authorization letter from OEM to tenderer is to be sub mitted.

17. All the accessories required for installation and commissioning including power supply unit, suitable RF cable with side connector, ground plane antenna, Gi Pipe, clamps and any other material required for commissioning are in the scope of bidder. 18. Programming of frequency of wireless set will be in the scope of bidder. 19. The dispatching address for the items is provided below- Indian Oil Corporation Ltd (MD), Jamshedpur LPG Bottling Plant, PO Gamaharia, Dist. Saraikell a Kharsawan, Jharkhand - 832108. 20. The above scope of work is in general and is not limited to the above. Successful tenderer has also to carry out all jobs (as per BOQ) not listed here but required for completion & all connected works in t oto. 21. Bidder shall be an OEM or an authorized dealer of the OEM for supplying wireless intrinsically safe ty pe digital handheld radio sets and shall have a full-fledged authorized service facility in India. 22. The work is supposed to be carried out on Single-point responsibility basis, which means that, even t hough not explicitly stated, the work involves design, conceptualization implementation along with e xecution. 23. The Radio shall be suitable for programming into several groups (Minimum of 6 groups). The radio sh all be site programmable. 24. The handheld radios shall be suitable for two-way communication and to operate in the VHF band, o n the frequencies assigned by WPC / DoT for Jamshedpur BP. 25. Bidder should be OEM authorised. OEM authorised letter and Manufacturers Authorization Form - MA F should be enclosed. 26. After installation & commissioning, field test / Site acceptance test (SAT) shall be performed, and the functional requirements and operation of the radio system shall be established. Tests shall include cl ear & uninterrupted voice communication of VHF radios, its response time, signal range, demonstrat ion of overall proper functionality of the system etc. as a minimum. Warranty of the system shall star t from the date of handover as recorded in the Minutes of Meeting after the performance test. 27. There will be a performance test after SAT for period of 30 days. IOCL shall take over then Digital VH F system after uninterrupted, satisfactory, trouble free, fully functional performance test for a period of one month after successful commissioning of system in totality & completion of all SAT punch poi nts at the site. Minutes of meeting shall be made for recording the date of handover of the system. U pon facing any issues faced during this period in any of the VHF sets or base station, bidder shall rep lace the defective piece with a new one. 28. Any other necessary licenses required for the VHFs if any, from any statutory bodies to be ensured b y the bidder. Any fee required for such licenses shall be paid by IOCL. 29. Minutes of Meeting shall be made for recording the date of handover of the items Guarantee of the it ems shall start from this date of handover. 30. It shall be obligatory on the part of the bidder to modify and/ or replace any hardware, in case any m alfunction is revealed even during online operation after taking over with warranty period. Bidder sh all also provide total maintenance of the supplied items including all spares during the guarantee per iod. Purchase Preference (PPP-MSE):

Will not be considered for pref 4 NO NO erential treatment. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. Past Project Experience Commercial Experience Criteria for Goods: For experience, the order(s) executed by the bidder, during the last five years ending on the last day of the month immediately preceding the month in which the last date of bid submission falls, should be considered as under: Three orders each executed for “similar item” Supply, with / without installation & commissioning, of Intrinsically Safe VHF Handheld Radio Sets / VHF Ba se Stations in any Plant/Office/Depot/Terminal in India. where executed value is not less than the amount equal to Rs. 395000 . OR Two orders each executed for “similar item” Supply, with / without installation & commissioning, of Intrinsically Safe VHF Handheld Radio Sets / VHF Ba se Stations in any Plant/Office/Depot/Terminal in India. where executed value is not less than the amount equal to Rs. 527000 . OR One order executed for “similar item” Supply, with / without installation & commissioning, of Intrinsically Safe VHF Handheld Radio Sets / VHF Ba se Stations in any Plant/Office/Depot/Terminal in India. where executed value is not less than the amount equal to Rs. 658000

. FOB/FCA/FOR Dispatch point price (inclusive of P&F, if any) shall be considered for arriving at the executed order value. However, in case any other cost component like TPI charges, Freight charges, Taxes & Duties etc. are not indicated separately and are already included in the Purchase Order Value, as evident from the submitted Purchase order copies, then executed order value shall include such inclusive cost components also for the purpose of PQC evaluation. Last date of order execution may fall in the above mentioned period i.e. within last five years ending on the last day of the month immediately preceding the month in which the last date of bid submission falls without considering any extensions. Foreign Orders in currency other than USD shall be converted to USD on the date of the said Purchase Order.
